notes.title: 【Dungeon Swordswoman】 Store Page Officially Unveiled
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/729367260b2330623d32dc4ffef581ac1cf25e56.png[/img]

[h1]【Dungeon Swordswoman】[/h1]  
[h2]Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches![/h2]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185540/_/?curator_clanid=45117199  

[h2]～ Story ～[/h2]  
The city thriving on trading treasures from its many labyrinths.

Sword Mistress, after opposing the city's powerful chambers' guild, is burdened with massive debt and forced to sign a contract that condemns her to a life of sexual slavery if she fails to repay.

Under the pressure of needing to earn a large sum of money in a short period of time, some men took advantage of the situation and made inappropriate demands...

Can Sword Mistress achieve her goal without compromising her dignity and her body ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/d56adb366d4ba58ae8d3dc2953f8312a6ee9a2b8.jpg[/img]  
Opposing the influential guild, Reese cannot access city facilities.  
Her only available lodging is a den for desperate adventurers craving a woman’s body.  

From the innkeeper and merchants to other adventurers, everyone desires Reese’s body and her eggs.  
At first, even minor harassment angers her,  

but through dubious services offered under the guise of fundraising, her sense of chastity begins to wane…  

[h2]～ Characters ～[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/cfabbb31db50f76818fc9ae2cabffc02cd7e6d8f.png[/img]
When Sword Mistress was a child, her family was deceived by the merchant guild, leading them into overwhelming debt and eventual ruin. 

Filled with hatred toward the guild, Sword Mistress vowed revenge. 

Relying on her exceptional swordsmanship talent, she became a vigilante thief, making a living by attacking the guild's caravans.

[h2]～ Gameplay ～[/h2]  
◆ Had to do all kinds of jobs just to pay off the debt!

[h3]◆ Bar[/h3]  
Sword Mistress works as a waitress...
At first it was just a bunny girl costume, but as the requirements became more and more exaggerated...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/e4f99f64b9c5de058fa74d81fc2b565d97daef53.jpg[/img]  

[h3]◆ Japanese Bathhouses[/h3]  
Sword Mistress, forced to bathe with strangers to earn money...
Although she used a special concealment spell to cover her important parts, still...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/b343eee78b2a570e13cb41d3a75f9a87c3b75e56.jpg[/img]  

[h3]◆ Repayment Failure (BAD END)[/h3]  
If she can't pay back the debt,

she’ll become the trading chamber's property, losing all her rights and everything else...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/5465aed4d81d4543de9d4790c2a53611411805b8.jpg[/img]  

[h2]～ System ～[/h2]  

[h3]◆ Roguelike System[/h3]  
Every time you enter the dungeon, the map, monsters, and dropped items are all random,

so each adventure is a completely new experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/680d916ee3ea9086c158b70474b53aea6abd7c73.jpg[/img]
[h3]◆ Items[/h3]  
Various items such as arrows, potions, scrolls, weapons, and chests appear randomly in the dungeon,

each with different additional abilities.

Besides being usable directly, some items can also be thrown to produce effects.

[h3]◆ Class and Skill Tree[/h3]

You can learn skills based on your preferences.

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  
[h2]~ COMING SOON ~[/h2]  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2311550/Slave_Princess_Finne__IF_Story_1/?curator_clanid=45117199  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320020/Slave_Princess_Finne__IF_Story_2/?curator_clanid=45117199  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343680/Slave_Princess_Finne__IF_Story_3/?curator_clanid=45117199  

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
